name: Hamuul Runetotem
summary: Tonga Runetotem sends you to Thunder Bluff as a strange taint spreads through the Barrens. He suspects the Wailing Caverns lie at its heart and seeks Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem’s counsel.

sections.title: A Disturbing Dream
sections.body: Near the Barrens’ oases, Tonga Runetotem found creatures marked by a strange affliction. An unnatural taint covered their shells, and Tonga came to believe the land itself was caught in a troubled dream. He suspects the waters flowing from the Wailing Caverns are to blame. Entering those caverns calls for more wisdom than one naturalist can offer.

sections.title: Counsel on Elder Rise
sections.body: Tonga sends you to Thunder Bluff for counsel from his kin, Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem. Hamuul is the highest-ranking tauren druid and a revered spiritual leader of the Cenarion Circle in Mulgore. From Elder Rise, he watches for disturbances across Kalimdor. He confirms the nightmare spreading through the Barrens is a dire threat, calling for the full might of Horde champions.

faq.q: Why does Tonga send me to Hamuul?
faq.answer: Tonga found a strange affliction among creatures near the Barrens’ oases and suspects the Wailing Caverns’ waters are its source. He sends you to Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff for Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem’s counsel before anyone enters the caverns.
Hamuul Runetotem is atop Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, the tauren capital in Mulgore. Other druids and shamans dwell there with him, overlooking the surrounding plains.

faq.q: What is the source of the taint Tonga noticed?
faq.answer: Tonga suspects underground springs in the Wailing Caverns are the source of the taint. Their strange waters corrupt local wildlife and flora, leaving the land seeming trapped in an inescapable nightmare.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Hamuul?
faq.answer: Hamuul welcomes you to Thunder Bluff and prepares you for what lies ahead. He warns that facing the nightmare beneath the Barrens is a dire undertaking, then directs you to Nara Wildmane to prepare for the descent into the Wailing Caverns.

Hamuul Runetotem leads the tauren druids and is a close childhood friend and advisor to High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. Since the Third War, he has learned the ways of the wild and guides tauren druids in communion with nature and the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: Is this quest required to enter the Wailing Caverns?
faq.answer: No. You can enter the Wailing Caverns without attunement, but this Horde story ties the mystery of the Barrens’ lush oases to the expedition inside the caverns.

angles.text: As a tauren druid, you come to Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem as a student of the mentor who established modern tauren druidism under Malfurion Stormrage’s teachings.
As a tauren, you see the concerns of your ancestral hunting grounds in the Barrens brought before the tribal elders atop Mulgore’s sacred bluffs.
As a member of the Horde, you know the Barrens is a crossroads for the young Horde. Investigating the spreading taint protects supply lines between Durotar, Mulgore, and the northern outposts.
